figs.name: square-root-extraction-dp-flow-loop-diagram
figs.alt: square root extraction in a DP flow loop with orifice plate, transmitter and extractor
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a DP flow loop: orifice plate, DP transmitter, square root extractor and a linear flow indicator or controller.
figs.after_h2: What Is a Square Root Extractor?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Square root extraction loop from orifice plate and DP transmitter to flow indicator</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Where Square Root Extraction Sits in a DP Flow Loop</text>
<rect x="20" y="100" width="300" height="60" fill="#e0f2fe" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="170" y1="92" x2="170" y2="120" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="6"/>
<line x1="170" y1="140" x2="170" y2="168" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="6"/>
<line x1="40" y1="130" x2="120" y2="130" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="210" y1="130" x2="300" y2="130" stroke="#0369a1" stroke-width="4" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="60" y="88" font-size="20" fill="#0369a1" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Q</text>
<text x="170" y="82" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Orifice plate</text>
<line x1="145" y1="160" x2="145" y2="250" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3"/>
<line x1="200" y1="160" x2="200" y2="250" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="132" y="215" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">HP</text>
<text x="212" y="215" font-size="17" fill="#2563eb" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">LP</text>
<rect x="120" y="250" width="150" height="70" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="195.0" y="279.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DP</text>
<text x="195.0" y="303.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">transmitter</text>
<text x="195" y="350" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">ΔP is proportional to Q²</text>
<line x1="272" y1="285" x2="330" y2="285" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="300" y="270" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">mA</text>
<rect x="330" y="240" width="180" height="90" rx="10" fill="#4338ca" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="420.0" y="267.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Square root</text>
<text x="420.0" y="290.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">extractor</text>
<text x="420.0" y="313.95" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">takes √ΔP</text>
<line x1="512" y1="285" x2="560" y2="285" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="560" y="240" width="220" height="90" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="670.0" y="267.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Indicator, recorder,</text>
<text x="670.0" y="290.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">controller, totaliser</text>
<text x="670.0" y="313.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">linear in flow</text>
<rect x="330" y="80" width="450" height="110" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="555" y="112" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flow doubles, ΔP rises four times</text>
<text x="555" y="142" font-size="20" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Q = k × √ΔP</text>
<text x="555" y="172" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Electronic or pneumatic device</text>
<rect x="20" y="390" width="760" height="90" rx="12" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="424" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Today the square root function is done inside the DP transmitter,</text>
<text x="400" y="452" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">a flow computer or the control system instead of a separate box.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: square-root-extraction-dp-flow-calculation-flowchart
figs.alt: square root extraction calculation from 8 mA DP signal to 12 mA flow signal
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing square root extraction in five steps: 8 mA is 25 percent of DP span, its square root is 0.50, giving 12 mA and 50 percent flow.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Square root extraction calculation steps from linear mA to flow mA</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Square Root Extraction Step by Step</text>
<rect x="60" y="62" width="680" height="66" rx="12" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="100" cy="95" r="20" fill="#4338ca"/>
<text x="100" y="101" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="140" y="103" font-size="19" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Read linear DP signal</text>
<text x="715" y="103" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">8 mA</text>
<line x1="400" y1="128" x2="400" y2="144" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="146" width="680" height="66" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="100" cy="179" r="20" fill="#4338ca"/>
<text x="100" y="185" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="140" y="187" font-size="19" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Percent of DP span</text>
<text x="715" y="187" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">(8 minus 4) ÷ 16 = 0.25</text>
<line x1="400" y1="212" x2="400" y2="228" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="230" width="680" height="66" rx="12" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="100" cy="263" r="20" fill="#4338ca"/>
<text x="100" y="269" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="140" y="271" font-size="19" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Take the square root</text>
<text x="715" y="271" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">√0.25 = 0.50</text>
<line x1="400" y1="296" x2="400" y2="312" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="314" width="680" height="66" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="100" cy="347" r="20" fill="#4338ca"/>
<text x="100" y="353" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="140" y="355" font-size="19" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Scale back to mA</text>
<text x="715" y="355" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">4 + 16 × 0.50 = 12 mA</text>
<line x1="400" y1="380" x2="400" y2="396" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="60" y="398" width="680" height="66" rx="12" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4338ca" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="100" cy="431" r="20" fill="#4338ca"/>
<text x="100" y="437" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<text x="140" y="439" font-size="19" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Read flow</text>
<text x="715" y="439" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">50 percent of full flow</text>
<rect x="60" y="490" width="680" height="54" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="524" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output mA = 4 + 16 × √[(input mA minus 4) ÷ 16]</text>
</svg>
